summary: Approximately 13,878 km² and about 399,440 people (2023), from Wikidata's Q778 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "The Bahamas", at revision 1374617659, opens: "The Bahamas, officially the Commonwealth of The Bahamas, is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean located within the Lucayan Archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean. The country comprises 700 islands, and more than 2,500 cays in the Atlantic Ocean, located north of Cuba and north-west of the island of Hispaniola and the Turks and Caicos Islands, southeast of the US state of Florida and east of the Florida Keys. The capital and largest city is Nassau on the island of New Providence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 31 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1973 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Nassau. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1973-07-10. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
